podcast.title: Original Proposal in Onda Siniestra (1980)
podcast.body: Founded in 1980, Los Monaguillos were considered one of the most original proposals within the "onda siniestra." Their sound was a unique combination of elements from Siouxsie (and the Banshees) and the psychedelic rock of the 1970s. "Los monaguillos fueron una de las propuestas más originales de la onda siniestra. Fundada en 1980, la banda tenía un sonido que combinaba elementos de Suxy y del rock más psicodélico de los años 70."

srcs.episode: La España Siniestra ｜ La edad de oro del Postpunk y el Dark wave

podcast.title: Unexpected Separation
podcast.body: After attracting significant attention from both the scene and specialized press with their LP "Voces en la jungla" and the single "Prisma de Agatas," Los Monaguillos unexpectedly separated, just as everyone was anticipating their next full-length album. "cuando todo el mundo estaba esperando su disco largo, contra todo pronóstico se separaron."
